hero.tagline: I build backend systems that power real products.
hero.description: I design REST APIs, model databases, and take applications to production on real Linux servers. I care about the architecture, performance, and business model behind every system, and I'm available for freelance projects of any scale: management systems, software products, landing pages, or institutional sites.

about.heading: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Full Stack developer with a backend focus, experienced in taking web applications from initial analysis and design through to production deployment and maintenance. I started out as an intern building an application to modernize the nursing department of a hospital, and today I work on enterprise web systems, involved in the full cycle: analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment.

My main interest is backend development and understanding the architecture that holds a system together: designing REST APIs, modeling relational databases and administering Linux servers in production. Without leaving frontend behind, I'm currently adding React to my stack to broaden that experience. I tend to work methodically — diagnosing a problem step by step before acting — and I'm genuinely curious about the why behind a technical decision, not just the how.

items.description: I take part in the full development cycle of enterprise web systems: analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment, both on new projects and on extending existing systems. I build REST APIs with Node.js, LoopBack 4 and NestJS, implement authentication with JWT and OAuth 2.0 (Auth0), build interfaces with Vue 3 and Vuetify, model relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), and deploy and maintain applications in production on DigitalOcean.
End-to-end backend and frontend development to modernize the hospital's nursing department, replacing manual paper-based processes with a web application.
Backend endpoint development with Spring Boot 3 as part of a university professional-practice scholarship.
